title: Raticate’s Balance Has Teeth
premise: Raticate’s whiskers keep it balanced, and touching them can earn an angry bite.
audiencePromise: Discover why Raticate treats its whiskers like the one thing nobody should touch.
openLoop: Why does Raticate defend a balance tool with an angry bite?
payoff: Its whiskers are essential for balance, and Raticate apparently slows down without them, making its warning feel earned.
engagementQuestion: Balance keeper or bite trigger: which defines Raticate better?

voice.instructions: Tense, curious, and quick. Land the hook like a strange warning. Build from anger to bite, then slow slightly for the balance reveal. End with a playful challenge.

scenes.headline: BALANCE HAS TEETH
scenes.caption: WHY WOULD A BALANCE TOOL BITE BACK?

scenes.headline: FRIENDLY IS NOT SAFE
scenes.narration: No matter how friendly you are, touching them makes it angry.
scenes.caption: FRIENDLY HANDS STILL MAKE RATICATE ANGRY.

scenes.headline: ANGER BECOMES A BITE
scenes.narration: Raticate gets angry and bites if you touch them.
scenes.caption: TOUCH ITS WHISKERS, AND IT BITES.

scenes.headline: THEY HOLD ITS BALANCE
scenes.narration: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance.
scenes.caption: THESE ARE NOT JUST FACE WHISKERS.

scenes.headline: LOSE THEM, SLOW DOWN
scenes.narration: Without whiskers, Raticate apparently starts moving more slowly.
scenes.caption: CUT THEM OFF, AND IT APPARENTLY SLOWS.

scenes.headline: BALANCE KEEPER. BITE TRIGGER.
scenes.narration: Balance keeper or bite trigger: which defines Raticate better?
scenes.caption: TOUCH ITS WHISKERS, AND IT GETS ANGRY.
